farraa:4-4.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ﴾.
Iblīs whispers in the breast of man, and when he remembers Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, he slinks back (خنس).

farraa:6-6.t:
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ﴾.
«الناس» here applies to the jinn and to mankind [Translator's note: the source has «النسا», evidently for «الناس»], as in your saying: he whispers in the breasts of people — their jinn and their humans. One of the Arabs said, while narrating: a group of jinn came and stood, and it was said: Who are you? They said: people (أناس) of the jinn. And Allah, Majestic and Mighty is He, said: ﴿أنّه اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنّ﴾, so He made «النفر» of the jinn as He made them of mankind; and He, Majestic and Mighty is He, said: ﴿وأَنَّهُ كان رِجالٌ من الإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ من الجنّ﴾, so He used «الرجال» of both jinn and mankind. And Allah knows best.
[The Book of al-Maʿānī is complete, and that is from Allah alone, who has no partner; praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; and may Allah bless Muhammad and his family and grant them peace.] [This blessed copy is complete, by the praise of Allah, His help and His good granting of success; and may Allah bless the one after whom there is no prophet, Muhammad, and his family and companions, and grant them abundant, everlasting peace until the Day of Judgement; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Amen.]
